scripts.build: bun run build:canvas && bun run build:viewer && bun run build:skill
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run diagrams && bun run build
scripts.build:canvas: vite build --outDir dist/app && bun build server/canvas.ts --target=node --outfile dist/canvas.js && rm -r dist/app
scripts.build:viewer: vite build --mode viewer --outDir dist/viewer && mv dist/viewer/index.html dist/viewer.html && rm -r dist/viewer
scripts.build:skill: mkdir -p dist/skill && cp skill/SKILL.md dist/canvas.js dist/skill/
scripts.install:skill: bun run build && mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/skills}/diagram-canvas" && cp dist/skill/* "${CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/skills}/diagram-canvas/"
